minor_findings.summary: Per-operation water allocations are not represented on the operation inputs.
minor_findings.evidence: The original assigns 30 mL of water to moisten and 2970 mL to boil. The candidate references the shared 3 L water ingredient at both operations and preserves the exact split only in ambiguities.

rationale: All twelve narrow operations, their linear dependency chain, ingredient uses, boiling duration, intermediate outputs, and final role are correct. The exact water split remains explicitly documented even though it is not encoded on the inputs.
